roadmap.title: Assassin's Creed III story
roadmap.description: Play Sequences 1 through 12 and the Present-day Desmond missions on any difficulty, taking each story unlock as it comes. Earn the combat and one-off achievements along the way: join a Club by skinning 10 animals, settle the first Artisan at the Homestead, buy one Aquila upgrade, block five firing lines with a human shield, and use a musket double assassination and a massed cannon shot when the chance appears.

roadmap.title: Assassin's Creed III 100% completion
roadmap.description: Free-roam cleanup once the story is done: finish every optional objective for Perfectionist, build the Homestead and fill the Encyclopedia of the Common Man, complete all four Clubs and their challenges, liberate Boston or New York, clear every collectible, Assassination Contract, Courier Mission and Delivery Request, fully upgrade the Aquila, and finish the Naval Missions, Naval Locations and Privateer Contracts. Close it out with Completionist.

roadmap.title: The Tyranny of King Washington
roadmap.description: Start a brand-new save for the DLC and never load the base-game import. Clear each episode's memories, optional objectives, Lucid Memory Artifacts and side missions for 100% synchronization in the Frontier, Boston and New York, and use each episode's animal power for its kill achievement.

roadmap.title: Assassin's Creed Liberation Remastered
roadmap.description: Pick Liberation Remastered from the Steam game selector and clear all sequences with every Constraint, then mop up the collectibles, persona missions, Business Rivals, Ship Crew missions, Pocket Watches and Dressing Chambers, and kill every Citizen E for the true ending.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 1.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 1 of Assassin's Creed Liberation Remastered.

guide.context: Liberation is started from the Steam game selector, not from the AC3 main menu.

steps.text: Play through Sequence 1's memories, then leave @loc{New Orleans} and kill the guards at the exit.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 2.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 2 of Assassin's Creed Liberation Remastered.

steps.text: Finish Sequence 2 through Memory #7, The Whole Truth, and report back to @npc{Agaté}.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 4.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 4 of Assassin's Creed Liberation Remastered.

steps.text: Finish Sequence 4 by escaping the collapsing @loc{Chichen Itza} temple.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 6.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 6 of Assassin's Creed Liberation Remastered.

steps.text: Finish Sequence 6's only memory, Return to Mexico, by collecting the @item{Prophecy Disk piece}.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 8.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 8 of Assassin's Creed Liberation Remastered.

steps.text: Finish Sequence 8's single memory in the New York Frontier by killing the marked target.

achievements.description: Complete the game (fake ending).
achievements.summary: Complete the main story to its fake ending.

steps.text: In the Sequence 9 Animus interlude, climb the three floors of the dismantled mansion to kill the last @enemy{Citizen E}, then let the credits resume.

achievements.description: Kill all Citizen E and experience the true ending.
achievements.summary: Kill every Citizen E and witness the true ending.

guide.context: Citizen E enemies are not marked on the map and appear as the story progresses; use @mechanic{Eagle Vision} to pick them out.

steps.text: Assassinate each Citizen E as it appears, including the spots at the top of the @loc{Chichen Itza} pyramid, in @loc{New Orleans}, in the wrecked ship in the eastern swamp and at the top of @loc{Saint Louis Cathedral}.
Kill the final Citizen E during the Sequence 9 Animus interlude, then complete Memory #4, Erudito, at Saint Louis Cathedral.
steps.note: If the achievement does not unlock there, replay Memory #4.

achievements.description: Achieve 100% Synchronization in all Sequences.
achievements.summary: Achieve 100% synchronization in every Liberation sequence.

guide.context: A missed Constraint means replaying that memory, so clear each memory's list as you go.

steps.text: Complete every optional Constraint in all story memories; there are 59 across the game.

achievements.description: Block 10 shots or firing lines with a human shield.
achievements.summary: Absorb 10 incoming shots or firing lines by using a grabbed enemy as a shield.

guide.context: Officers carry flintlocks and shoot most reliably.

steps.text: Provoke six or more guards in a @loc{New Orleans fort or square} so some hang back and shoot, then grab a nearby guard as a shield and hold it up to block. Use thrown counters to keep enemies alive and reusable.

achievements.description: Collect all diary pages, alligator eggs, Mayan statuettes, and mushrooms.
achievements.summary: Collect the full Liberation set: 12 alligator eggs, 30 diary pages, 10 Mayan statuettes and 10 mushrooms.

guide.context: Collectibles only show on the map when you get close, and two of the Mayan Statuettes sit inside story memories, so grab those during the mission.

steps.text: Gather the 30 @item{Jeanne's Diary Pages}, 12 @item{Alligator Eggs} and 10 @item{Mushrooms} while exploring @loc{New Orleans}, the @loc{Bayou} and @loc{Chichen Itza}.
Collect the 10 @item{Mayan Statuettes}, two of which sit only inside the Sequence 4 Chichen Itza cenote memory and the Sequence 6 Return to Mexico memory.

achievements.description: Collect every persona-specific collectible.
achievements.summary: Collect all 30 persona-specific collectibles in Liberation.

guide.context: Precious Stones need the Lady persona, who cannot climb, so watch for ladders near some of them.

steps.text: As the Assassin, kill and loot the marked muggers for all 10 @item{Assassin Coins}.
As the Slave, pickpocket the marked Houngans for all 10 @item{Voodoo Dolls}.
As the Lady, charm the marked gentlemen for all 10 @item{Precious Stones}.

achievements.description: Kill 5 guards in 15 seconds using only the Sugarcane Machete (without using the Chain Kill).
achievements.summary: Take down 5 guards within 15 seconds with only the Sugarcane Machete, without a Chain Kill.

guide.context: A smoke bomb keeps the group together, and double counter kills help beat the timer.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Sugarcane Machete}, gather a group of guards, then counter and kill five of them within 15 seconds without using the Chain Kill.

achievements.description: Survive 10 animal encounters.
achievements.summary: Survive 10 animal encounters in Liberation.

guide.context: An animal killed before it enters combat does not count, so let every encounter start properly.

steps.text: While collecting @item{Alligator Eggs}, let each guarding alligator attack and kill it with the quick-time events. Repeat ten times.

achievements.description: Buy the maximum number of ships (8).
achievements.summary: Buy the maximum of 8 trade ships.

guide.context: Keep the trade system running for income, then swap the Galleons for Barques once the collection achievements are done.

steps.text: Buy seven more ships from the trade menu; seven @item{Galleons} at 3,700₠ each is the cheapest route, 25,900₠ in total.

achievements.description: Tree run for 10 branches without touching the ground.
achievements.summary: Tree run across 10 branches without touching the ground.

guide.context: Any ten branches count, not ten separate trees, and the Bayou has long connected runs to use.

steps.text: In the @loc{Bayou}, leap from branch to branch through the tree canopy and keep going until ten branches have been crossed without landing.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a poison dart.
achievements.summary: Take out an enemy using a blowpipe poison dart.

steps.text: Get the @item{blowpipe} from @npc{Agaté} in Sequence 2, then hit any guard with a @item{poison dart}.

achievements.description: Complete all persona-specific side missions.
achievements.summary: Finish all 15 persona side missions in Liberation.

guide.context: The Plot missions are in New Orleans, and the Detective missions run between New Orleans and the Bayou.

steps.text: Finish the five @mechanic{Assassin Contracts}, the five @mechanic{The Plot} missions for the Lady and the five @mechanic{Detective} missions for the Slave.

achievements.description: Kill 25 enemies with the Parasol Gun.
achievements.summary: Take down 25 enemies using the Parasol Gun.

guide.context: Only the enemy you shoot counts, not anyone a berserk target kills.

steps.text: As the Lady, equip the @item{Parasol Gun} and kill enemies with @item{poison} and @item{berserk poison darts} until the counter reaches 25.

achievements.description: Buy your 1st Dressing Chamber.
achievements.summary: Buy your first Dressing Chamber.

steps.text: Use the money from @npc{Gérald} in Sequence 1 Memory #7 to buy the marked @item{Dressing Chamber}.

achievements.description: Buy every Dressing Chamber.
achievements.summary: Buy every Dressing Chamber in Liberation.

steps.text: Buy the 10 @item{Dressing Chambers} around @loc{New Orleans}, then the remaining three in the @loc{Bayou}.

achievements.description: Pickpocket 5000 écu.
achievements.summary: Pickpocket 5,000₠ in total.

guide.context: Bribe a herald or magistrate, then pickpocket the same person to recover the money and add it to the total.

steps.text: Pickpocket civilians throughout the game; the best-dressed targets carry the most currency.

achievements.description: Perform 10 predator moves using the Whip.
achievements.summary: Hang 10 enemies with the Whip's predator move.

guide.context: Only the hanging execution counts; dragging an enemy over and killing them on the spot does not.

steps.text: From a tree branch or beam, grab an enemy below with the @item{whip} and drop backwards off the perch to hang them. Repeat ten times.

achievements.description: Collect all the pocket watches.
achievements.summary: Collect all 10 Pocket Watches.

guide.context: The final four watches cost 21,250₠, 28,750₠, 35,000₠ and 43,750₠, so keep trade ships running for income.

steps.text: Buy each @item{Pocket Watch} from a Smuggler as it becomes available; the full set costs 166,000₠.

achievements.description: Use berserk poison to force an enemy to kill 5 enemies.
achievements.summary: Use berserk poison to make one enemy kill 5 others.

guide.context: This is not cumulative: one berserk enemy must land all five kills, so reload the checkpoint and retry if he is stopped.

steps.text: In Sequence 3's convoy memory, hit the Captain in the white jacket with a @item{berserk poison dart}, then throw a @item{smoke bomb} so the surrounding guards stay in range while he kills them.

achievements.description: Synchronize all viewpoints.
achievements.summary: Synchronize all 19 viewpoints in Liberation.

steps.text: Sync the 13 @loc{New Orleans} viewpoints and the 6 @loc{Bayou} viewpoints.

achievements.description: Complete every Business Rivals mission.
achievements.summary: Complete every Business Rivals mission.

guide.context: Several have constraints such as staying undetected or using the Lady persona, so read each mission's list before starting.

steps.text: Finish all seven @mechanic{Business Rivals} missions: six in @loc{New Orleans} and one in the @loc{Bayou}.

achievements.description: Complete every Ship Crew mission.
achievements.summary: Complete every Ship Crew mission.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Mistress & Commander}, @mechanic{The Cannon} and @mechanic{Before the Mast}.

achievements.description: Complete every Bayou Fever mission.
achievements.summary: Complete all 9 Bayou Fever missions.

steps.text: Take the @mechanic{Bayou Fever} job from the @npc{Witch Doctor} in the north-east @loc{Bayou}, gather the marked @item{Mushrooms} for him, then cure all nine victims around the swamp.

achievements.description: Complete every Free Slaves mission.
achievements.summary: Complete every Free Slaves mission.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{A Family Divided}, @mechanic{Earthly Belongings} and @mechanic{A New Recruit}.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy from a tree, with the blowpipe, while using eagle vision.
achievements.summary: Take out an enemy with the blowpipe from a tree while Eagle Vision is active.

steps.text: Get into a tree above a guard (tilted logs count too), activate @mechanic{Eagle Vision}, then free-aim a @item{Fast Poison Dart} down at the guard.

achievements.description: Re-Enter the Animus.
achievements.summary: Re-enter the Animus during the opening Present Day tutorial.

steps.text: As Desmond, enter the @loc{Grand Temple} and play the Animus tutorial memory through to its end.

achievements.description: Complete Present - Stadium.
achievements.summary: Complete the Present Day mission Stadium.

steps.text: After Sequence 8, follow the green signs through the @loc{Brazil stadium} undetected, chase @npc{Cross}, take the @item{Abstergo Battery} and escape.

achievements.description: Complete Present - Skyscraper.
achievements.summary: Complete the Present Day mission Skyscraper.

steps.text: After Sequence 5, play the Present-day Skyscraper mission and take the @item{Abstergo Battery} from the Manhattan tower.

achievements.description: Complete Present - Abstergo.
achievements.summary: Complete the Present Day mission Abstergo.

steps.text: After Sequence 10, break into the @loc{Abstergo facility in Italy}, rescue Desmond's father and fight your way back out.

achievements.description: Open the Temple Door and learn Desmond's fate.
achievements.summary: Open the Grand Temple door and witness Desmond's fate.

steps.text: After Sequence 12, pick up the @item{First Civilization Amulet} at @loc{Davenport}.
Take it to the @loc{Grand Temple} and use it on the final seal to open the door.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 1 & 2.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequences 1 and 2 of the Assassin's Creed III story.

steps.text: Finish Sequence 2 by assassinating @npc{Silas Thatcher} at @loc{Southgate}.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 3.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 3 of the Assassin's Creed III story.

steps.text: Finish Sequence 3, then walk into the @loc{Green Dragon Tavern} in Boston for the debrief.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 4.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 4 of the Assassin's Creed III story.

steps.text: Finish Sequence 4's last memory, Something to Remember.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 5.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 5 of the Assassin's Creed III story.

steps.text: Finish Sequence 5, return to @loc{Davenport Homestead} and put on the Assassin's garb.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 6.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 6 of the Assassin's Creed III story.

steps.text: Kill @npc{William Johnson} in @loc{John's Town}, then escape the restricted area to finish Sequence 6.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 7.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 7 of the Assassin's Creed III story.

steps.text: Finish Sequence 7 by killing @npc{John Pitcairn} at @loc{Bunker Hill}, then loot the letter from his body.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 8.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 8 of the Assassin's Creed III story.

steps.text: Finish Sequence 8 by killing @npc{Thomas Hickey} in New York.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 9.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 9 of the Assassin's Creed III story.

steps.text: Finish Sequence 9 by dealing with @npc{Benjamin Church}.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 10.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 10 of the Assassin's Creed III story.

steps.text: Finish Sequence 10, which ends at the @loc{Battle of Monmouth}.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 11.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 11 of the Assassin's Creed III story.

steps.text: Finish Sequence 11 by lighting the signal fire at @loc{Fort George}, then escaping the city.

achievements.description: Complete Sequence 12.
achievements.summary: Complete Sequence 12 of the Assassin's Creed III story.

steps.text: Finish Sequence 12 by tracking @npc{Charles Lee} to the Monmouth tavern and killing him.

achievements.description: Complete 100% of all main mission constraints.
achievements.summary: Complete 100% of the optional objectives in every main story mission.

guide.context: Optional objectives in the Naval Missions, Naval Locations and Privateer Contracts are not part of this achievement.

steps.text: Clear the optional objectives listed for every story memory across Sequences 1 to 12.
steps.note: If one fails, reload the last checkpoint and retry it before the memory ends.

achievements.description: Complete the Encyclopedia of the Common Man.
achievements.summary: Finish the Encyclopedia of the Common Man by scanning all of the Homestead Artisans.

guide.context: Artisans only work in daylight and the game has no wait feature, so replaying a daytime memory such as River Rescue is the way to reset the clock.

steps.text: Find each Artisan while they work and scan them three times in @mechanic{Eagle Vision}, aiming with the bow or pistol until the circle fills.
steps.note: An Artisan glows gold when the job they are doing counts; track remaining entries in the Logbook.

achievements.description: Craft one of Franklin's inventions to decorate your Manor.
achievements.summary: Craft one of Benjamin Franklin's inventions to decorate the Manor.

guide.context: Two of the nine inventions need a Level 4 Blacksmith, but the rest are craftable as soon as the pages are collected.

steps.text: Collect the Boston and New York @item{Almanac Pages} to unlock the inventions.
Open the crafting logbook at a General Store or in the Manor and craft any one invention.

achievements.description: Recruit any of the Artisans and see them settled on the Homestead.
achievements.summary: Settle an Artisan on the Homestead.

guide.context: @npc{Godfrey} and @npc{Terry} do not count; every later Artisan does.

steps.text: Complete the Homestead mission The Whittler's Weapons on the road by the Frontier fast-travel point to rescue @npc{Lance}, then let him move into @loc{Davenport}.

achievements.description: See all the optional characters settled at the Homestead.
achievements.summary: Settle all 10 optional characters at the Homestead.

guide.context: The full roster only opens up after Sequence 8.

steps.text: Complete the Homestead missions and recruitment quests that bring every optional resident to @loc{Davenport}, including @npc{Father Timothy} and his church.

achievements.description: Win a game of Fanorona, Morris and Bowls on the Homestead.
achievements.summary: Win one game each of Fanorona, Morris and Bowls at the Homestead.

guide.context: The Bowls tutorial and the docks game do not count, and a game won with a 0£ bet or a draw is not recorded.

steps.text: Win @mechanic{Bowls} against the Lumberers.
Win @mechanic{Fanorona} against @npc{Achilles} at the Manor.
Win @mechanic{Nine Men's Morris} against @npc{Oliver} at Mile's End Tavern.

achievements.description: Explore Fort Wolcott.
achievements.summary: Explore Fort Wolcott.

steps.text: Sail to the @loc{Fort Wolcott} naval location, infiltrate the fort, take @item{Captain Kidd's Treasure Map} and escape back to the Aquila.

achievements.description: Uncover the mystery of Oak Island.
achievements.summary: Uncover the mystery of Oak Island.

guide.context: The four Captain Kidd map fragments come from the Peg Leg Trinket quests and the naval locations Fort Wolcott, The Ghost Ship, Dead Chest's Treasure and The Mad Doctor's Castle.

steps.text: Collect the @item{Peg Leg Trinkets} and clear those naval locations to assemble all four @item{Captain Kidd Letters}.
Sail to @loc{Oak Island}, match the symbols at each of the four landmark viewpoints, then blow the marked spot open with powder kegs and dive through the cavern to the @item{Shard of Eden}.

achievements.description: Complete all Naval Missions aboard the Aquila.
achievements.summary: Complete all four Naval Missions aboard the Aquila.

guide.context: Each Naval Mission's optional objectives are also required for Completionist.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{The Chase}, @mechanic{The Rescue}, @mechanic{French Involvement} and @mechanic{Biddle's Hideout} from the Atlantic Ocean map.

achievements.description: Complete all 12 Privateer Contracts.
achievements.summary: Complete every Privateer Contract.

guide.context: Contracts unlock in groups as the story advances, and each one's optional objectives are also required for Completionist.

steps.text: Take every @mechanic{Privateer Contract} from the harbormaster menu and finish it, including the sets that unlock with later sequences.

achievements.description: Upgrade the Aquila.
achievements.summary: Upgrade the Aquila.

guide.context: All eight upgrades are needed for Completionist.

steps.text: Buy any Aquila upgrade from @npc{Robert Faulkner}; the cheapest is the Extra Cannon for 2,500£.

achievements.description: Be invited to join a Club.
achievements.summary: Be invited to join a Club.

guide.context: Each Club invites you once you clear one of its challenges.

steps.text: Hunt and skin 10 animals to be invited into the Hunting Society.

achievements.description: Complete all challenges for any of the Clubs.
achievements.summary: Complete all challenges for any Club.

guide.context: The Progress Tracker wants every Club's challenges anyway, so none of the work is wasted.

steps.text: Finish all three tiers of @mechanic{Hunting Society} challenges: skin animals, use bait with snares, trade hunting spoils and kill animals with the hidden blade and bow.

achievements.description: Liberate all districts in Boston OR New York.
achievements.summary: Liberate every district in Boston or New York.

guide.context: Liberation Missions only appear after you physically explore an area, so uncover the map before hunting for them.

steps.text: Clear the Liberation Missions in every district of one city, then finish each district's final Liberation Mission to free the district and recruit its assassin.

achievements.description: Send a convoy to Boston, New York and the Frontier.
achievements.summary: Send one convoy to merchants in Boston, New York and the Frontier.

guide.context: It unlocks when the convoys depart, so there is no need to wait for their return.

steps.text: Craft at least three land convoys from Oak Lumber and Oak Bark, then use an accounting book to send one loaded convoy to a merchant in each of the three regions.

achievements.description: Retrieve every page for one of Ben Franklin's Almanacs.
achievements.summary: Collect all four pages of a single Ben Franklin Almanac volume.

steps.text: Buy the almanac map at any General Store, then collect all four @item{Almanac Pages} belonging to a single volume.

achievements.description: Complete ALL progress tracker grid entries.
achievements.summary: Complete every Progress Tracker grid entry.

steps.text: Finish every story memory and its optional objectives, complete all 35 Homestead missions and fully upgrade the Aquila.
Complete all four Clubs and their challenges, liberate every district in Boston and New York, and bring all six Assassin recruits to rank 11.
Clear every Assassination Contract, Courier Mission and Delivery Request, and take all seven forts.
Collect every Almanac, Chest, Feather and Peg Leg Trinket, assemble @item{Captain Kidd's treasure}, and craft all nine Franklin inventions.
Discover every Underground fast-travel point in both cities and finish all Naval Missions, Naval Locations and Privateer Contracts with their optional objectives.

achievements.description: Complete 50% of the Progress Tracker entries.
achievements.summary: Fill in half of the Progress Tracker entries.

steps.text: Keep working through the Progress Tracker checklist; the tracker passes half as the completion work adds up, or sooner if the Privateer Contracts are already cleared.

achievements.description: Perform a double assassination using a musket.
achievements.summary: Perform a double assassination with a musket.

steps.text: Take a loaded @item{musket} from a weapon rack or disarm a soldier to get one.
Find two enemies standing in a line, sprint into the nearer one to impale it with the bayonet, then fire a @mechanic{Reflex Shot} through the body to kill the second.
steps.note: Approach from straight in front or behind; a side-on impalement leaves no line to the second enemy.

achievements.description: Kill 15 guards with a single cannon shot.
achievements.summary: Take out 15 guards with one cannon shot.

guide.context: A platoon is roughly eight soldiers, so a centred shot across two bunched platoons clears the total.

steps.text: In Sequence 10's @loc{Battle of Monmouth}, let two or more platoons bunch together, then fire the cannon into the middle of the group.

achievements.description: Hang 5 enemies by using rope darts.
achievements.summary: Hang 5 enemies with rope darts.

guide.context: Only the hanging execution counts; pulling a guard down and killing him while still on the perch does not.

steps.text: From a beam above a lone guard, fire a @item{rope dart} to reel him in, then drop backwards off the beam to hang him. Repeat five times.

achievements.description: Loot a convoy without killing any of its guards.
achievements.summary: Loot a convoy while leaving every guard alive.

guide.context: A convoy spawns on the @loc{Black Creek} road running toward Concord; fast travel back to the fort and re-run the road until one appears.

steps.text: Equip bare fists and sneak up behind the convoy to knock out the four guards at the back one at a time.
Move to the front and knock out the remaining guards with fist counters, using @item{Smoke Bombs} if the melee gets crowded.
steps.note: Kicking a downed guard, gunfire or a bad counter can kill a guard and void the attempt.

steps.text: When every guard is down but alive, loot the convoy.

achievements.displayName: Whit's fur ye'll no go by ye!
achievements.description: Block a firing line 5 times by using a human shield.
achievements.summary: Block a firing line 5 times using a human shield.

guide.context: Human Shields are taught at @loc{Southgate} in Sequence 2, so that memory can be replayed from a checkpoint to farm blocks.

steps.text: When the game warns that a firing line is aiming at you, grab a nearby enemy with the human shield move and hold them up to absorb the shot. Repeat until five blocks register.

achievements.description: After becoming fully Notorious, kill 10 Jagers before losing your notoriety.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 Jägers at full Notoriety without letting your wanted level fall.

guide.context: Jägers may not appear until Sequence 8 is complete, and fast travel or lowering notoriety resets the tally. The Boston Brawlers challenge to disarm and kill 10 Jägers can be worked on at the same time.

steps.text: Raise @mechanic{Notoriety} to level 3 so @enemy{Jägers} spawn and track you down.
With bare fists equipped, disarm each Jäger and kill it with its own weapon. Repeat until ten are down without fast travelling.

achievements.description: Have a Trainee reach the Assassin Rank.
achievements.summary: Have an Assassin recruit reach the Assassin rank.

guide.context: Completionist needs all six recruits at rank 11, so spread the contracts instead of focusing on one recruit.

steps.text: Send recruits on @mechanic{Assassination Contracts} from the Assassin wheel until one reaches rank 11, which needs 1,100 XP.

achievements.description: Exchange undamaged pelts at all different general stores.
achievements.summary: Exchange undamaged pelts at all nine General Stores.

guide.context: A pelt is undamaged only if the animal dies to a melee weapon or the bow; the item description reads hide is in perfect condition. Roaming consumable merchants do not count.

steps.text: Sell an intact @item{pelt} at the three Boston stores, the three New York stores, and the Frontier stores at Monmouth, Concord and Lexington.

achievements.description: Witness a predator killing an enemy.
achievements.estTime: until a predator kills a guard
achievements.summary: Witness a predator kill an enemy.

guide.context: It often unlocks on its own during Frontier free roam.

steps.text: Go to a Frontier area with @enemy{wolves}, @enemy{cougars} or @enemy{bears}, find stationary guards, drop @item{bait} beside them, then hide and wait for a predator to attack.

achievements.description: Complete each of the epilogue missions unlocked after the credits roll.
achievements.summary: Complete each epilogue mission unlocked after the credits roll.

steps.text: Play Evacuation Day from the carriage at the eastern @loc{New York} harbour.
Play Kanatahséhtpn in the @loc{Kanièn:keh} region of the Frontier.

achievements.description: Receive an unexpected gift. (TOKW: Infamy)
achievements.summary: Receive a surprise gift during Episode 1 of The Tyranny of King Washington.

guide.context: Start a brand-new save for the DLC; loading the base-game import in the Player slot stops side progress from saving.

steps.text: Play Episode 1 up to the village scene where Connor is given the @item{Hidden Blade}.

achievements.description: Kill 25 enemies while staying cloaked. (TOKW: Infamy)
achievements.summary: Kill 25 enemies while cloaked in Episode 1.

guide.context: The memory where Connor's equipment is stolen gives a long stretch of cloaked kills, so it unlocks early.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Wolf Cloak} whenever it is available and kill or assassinate @enemy{Bluecoats} from stealth throughout Episode 1.

achievements.description: Reach 100% synchronization in the Frontier. (TOKW: Infamy)
achievements.summary: Earn 100% synchronization across the Frontier in Episode 1.

guide.context: Do this before the episode's final memory, or the whole episode has to be replayed. Chests are optional, but their weapons and upgrades carry into later episodes.

steps.text: Complete all six Episode 1 memories and all ten of their optional objectives.
Find all three @item{Lucid Memory Artifacts}: at @loc{Lexington}, at the church in the @loc{Valley Forge} Bluecoat camp, and in the bay south-east of @loc{Kanatahséton} village.
Complete all three Frontier side mission types.

achievements.description: Defeat Benedict Arnold. (TOKW: Infamy)
achievements.summary: Defeat Benedict Arnold in Episode 1.

steps.text: Finish Episode 1's Memory #6: use @mechanic{Wolf Cloak} to slip into the @loc{Black Creek} fort and assassinate @npc{Benedict Arnold}.

achievements.description: Use Eagle Flight to travel 1 km. (TOKW: Betrayal)
achievements.summary: Travel 1 km with Eagle Flight in Episode 2.

steps.text: After clearing the warehouse guards in Episode 2, use @mechanic{Eagle Flight} to fly back and forth through the rafters; the room is about 100 m long.

achievements.description: Reach 100% synchronization in Boston. (TOKW: Betrayal)
achievements.summary: Earn 100% synchronization across Boston in Episode 2.

steps.text: Complete all nine Episode 2 memories and all seventeen of their optional objectives.
Complete all four Boston side mission types and find all three @item{Lucid Memory Artifacts}.

achievements.description: Defeat Putnam. (TOKW: Betrayal)
achievements.summary: Defeat Putnam in Episode 2.

steps.text: Finish Episode 2 by killing @npc{Israel Putnam} at the @loc{Boston docks}, targeting him with an @mechanic{Eagle Assassination} while an animal power is active.

achievements.description: Kill 125 enemies using Bear Might. (TOKW: Redemption)
achievements.summary: Kill 125 enemies with Bear Might in Episode 3.

guide.context: Bear Might can only be used about twice per fight before health runs out.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Bear Might} in every fight through Episode 3, especially while clearing the New York side missions.

achievements.displayName: If I Can Make It There
achievements.description: Reach 100% synchronization in New York. (TOKW: Redemption)
achievements.summary: Earn 100% synchronization across New York in Episode 3.

steps.text: Complete all eight Episode 3 memories and all fourteen of their optional objectives.
Complete all four New York side mission types and find all three @item{Lucid Memory Artifacts}.

achievements.description: Defeat George Washington. (TOKW: Redemption)
achievements.summary: Defeat George Washington in Episode 3.

steps.text: Finish Episode 3's Memory #8 boss fight by cycling animal powers against @npc{King Washington}.
